name: CStrId_Destroy

name: CStrId_ConstructFromRntString

reason: constructs a string pool buffer (a borrowed string) from a text, length and key

reason: assigns a text, length and key to a string pool buffer

reason: whether the string pool's buffer differs from a C string; null and empty are equal

reason: sets up the string pool's function-local static heap with a fixed number of blocks per size class

name: StringPool_Bucket
reason: returns the address of a bucket head of the pool's hash set

name: StringHeap_Init
reason: sets up the string heap's size classes from a table of block counts

reason: allocates a block from the string heap; the block's first field is the memory

name: StringHeap_Free
reason: returns a block to the string heap

name: AddReflectedFunction

name: TypeAttributes
